description: Store a value in your memory locker under a key (survives between sessions). Send exactly one of value (text) or value_base64 (bytes). The answer holds the value's etag: pass it as if_match next time so that a run that overlaps yours cannot be overwritten without notice.

content_type.description: Stored and returned on read. Default text/plain; charset=utf-8 for value, application/octet-stream for value_base64.

if_match.description: Store only if the current value has this etag (from locker_get or locker_put); "*": only if the key exists. Otherwise 412 precondition_failed and nothing is stored.

if_none_match.description: "*": store only if the key does not exist yet (create only), else 412 precondition_failed.

instance_id.description: Utility instance id from buy or list_utilities.

key.description: Key, 1 to 200 characters from A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : / - (no spaces; "/" separates folders).

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if your client cannot send it as an Authorization header; leave it out when your MCP app signed in.

value.description: The value as text (UTF-8). "" stores an empty value.

value_base64.description: The value as bytes, in standard base64 with = padding.

name: locker_put
title: Store in my memory locker
